articles.summary: today announced the expansion of its long-standing partnership with Kendall Jenner , elevating her role to Global Creative Director of FWRD and naming her a REVOLVE Los Angeles Ambassador . One of fashion's most influential voices, Jenner has been an integral part of the REVOLVE ecosystem for nearly a decade. Following early collaborations with the brand, she was appointed Creative Director of FWRD in 2021. Since then, she has helped shape the luxury retailer's fashion authority through curated product edits, emerging designer discovery, and elevated brand storytelling. As Global Creative Director of FWRD , Jenner will continue to guide the luxury retailer's digital creative direction across brand curation, monthly trend edits, and major marketing initiatives. In addition to this expanded role at FWRD , Jenner will now serve as a REVOLVE Los Angeles ambassador, extending her partnership across the REVOLVE Group portfolio.
